title: Wirtschaftspädagogik
bookshelves: Category: Economics, Finance, Business and Management
summary: Drawing on a broad understanding of the discipline, this book spans the arc from the origins of business education (Wirtschaftspädagogik) through its fields of practice to the development of professional competence in the field and the current research priorities at the Institute of Business Education at the University of Graz. This is the third, fully revised and expanded edition of a textbook on business education from an Austrian perspective — designed both as a foundational resource and companion for students, and as a reference for all others with an interest in the field.
